reviews.t: Great if you figure out the right method.
reviews.x: I have been on the hunt for a no heat way to curl my hair.  I’ve had a perm, but I don’t like the damage it does, making my hair feel like straw.  I bought the smaller flex rods, but those make me look like Shirley Temple. These 1” diameter rods give me the look I want.  I’ve only slept on them once. That was super uncomfortable. So I use a keratin smoothing product and get my hair only slightly damp. I use two packs (8 rollers). I really like the result.

These rods are AMAZING! They did wonders for my hair! It took a little practice to get my curls this flawless but don’t give up! I watched a YouTube video for the “wrap” method instead of the tradition roll that one thinks of when they use rollers. Steps I took: 1) wash hair, let it mostly air dry 2) add a little bit of hair oil 3) wrap and sleep 4) wake up,finger brush the curls out, hair spray and go! They’re not the most comfortable to sleep in but they’re not bad. I’ve got long and thick hai

I love these rollers.  I have them in many dimensions.  I have baby-fine, wavy hair, prone to frizz at the slightest hint of humidity.  After using flat irons and curling irons to smooth and seal my hair, the heat damage was making my hair break and look thin.  So I stopped using irons, cut the damaged ends off, and started a regimen of conditioning my hair with jojoba oils, etc...  But what to do about the frizz?!?!? I have really long, layered hair, and I don't like to use heat to curl it (too much damage). I saw a video on Youtube about using these sort of rollers, and decided to try these. My hair had big, bouncy curls that stayed in all day. I live in Hawaii where it's very humid, so that's quite a feat. I had to get two packs to make sure I had enough rollers for my thick hair. I'm telling you straight up, this is sooooooooooooo much better than standing in front of a mirror holding a curling iron. Very comfortable and great quality too. I bought a two pack of these, a two pack for the gray 11/16 rollers and the purple 3/4 rollers from Annie. Put the big green rollers on top, medium in the middle and small on the bottom. Do it at night. Wake up in the morning and you have luscious beautiful curls ~ that definitely turn heads!
I purchased this product for doing beach wave perms. Super easy to use and to clean.

reviews.t: The best bendy rollers/Flexi rods I have ever used !
reviews.x: These are the best jumbo bendy rollers/Flexi rods I have ever used ! They are so easy to use and give such gorgeous waves (Just like what you would get if you had done a rollerset on your hair). You get those gorgeous, wide, spiral curls that would compliment anyone. They bend quite easily, which is a surprise since I have heard jumbo flexi rods are difficult to bend. You do have to have long hair in order to use them properly. It will also hold better if you have thick hair with texture to it.

reviews.t: Great for curly hair that doesnt have a pretty natural curl
reviews.x: I have gorgeous hair, when it is styled. I have long curly/wavy hair that does not have a pretty curl pattern — usually dries frizzy with some curls and some waves and does not look very nice. My usual routine was to let it air dry and then use a curling iron to tame it. Now I let it air dry to about 50-75% dry, then use these rods to dry to 90% then take them out and I have to say my hair looks soooo good. Zero heat. More natural-looking than taking the curling iron to it. Took some time to fig

reviews.t: I like the body but not the kink
reviews.x: I got these to tame my natural curls. I like  the body but not the kink.  They are excellent for body, though if your hair is at yoiur shoulder blades or above, you will want a thinner one.

I didn't have the problem others did with the rollers not bending.  They worked just fine.  However, I have fine hair with soft texture and after allowing time for drying, these gave me a really lovely loose curl for only about 15 minutes.  Then the progressive loosening began. By the 2 hr mark, I just looked like I had bed head.  Not really what I was hoping for. So if you have hair that loves to curl, these would probably be ideal. I would also recommend the Softhood dryer. It's a throwback to

reviews.t: Provide long-lasting, bouncy curls without the headache
reviews.x: These are soft and pliable.  I find them a nice alternative to curling and flat irons. The curls from these last several days (personal experience) and the curls are fluffy and bouncy. The larger the roller, the larger the curl.  Mixing them with different size rods has been very successful and gain many compliments. They require being applied to dampened hair if hair is fine, straight. They are soft to sleep on, and when I'm in a hurry and applied for a half hour or so or while showering, they

These do not work.  They are not long enough to bend the ends over to hold the wrapped hair in place.  In addition, the foam is so thick, which is what I wanted for a large curl, that the wire inside isn't strong enough to hold it anyway.  The small ones work but make a tight curl. This is just a failed design.  Don't waste your money, seller won't refund it but Amazon will if you go to the trouble to ask.  If I could give zero stars I would.  These will go in the trash.

reviews.t: Perfect for overnight shape by morning
reviews.x: Love them. Perfect for wrapping my hair around at night to give my long hair a little shape by morning. I actually use only one rod, gather my hair up as though making a ponytail in the back, then wrap around and twist each end in to secure. I'll use two, one on each side like Princess Leia if I want a little more curl. :) They are comfortable to sleep in and have never undone. Exactly what I was looking for.

Love these for the pliability, easy to put in; provide long-lasting curls; easy to sleep in; quick to curl; easy to pack when traveling.  Note hair should be relatively long (at least 14") to effectively use these because they are really big. They are nice for a page-boy look.

reviews.t: These are great for big relaxed waves
reviews.x: These are great for big relaxed waves.  I saw a few reviews that said they don't work and they slip out, but I think that may be due to user error.  However I watched a few youtube videos showing how these work, you have to bend them back on themselves for them to hold in place.

reviews.t: I am so pleased with the results!
reviews.x: I already have small spiral texture hair which is right above my thighs and the length and width of these rollers are just perfect for me and the results are amazing and most importantly......withOUT heat!!

reviews.t: If you have very long hair and don't want tight curls these are for you!
reviews.x: Had no issues bending the ends; had been searching local beauty store for large rods this size

reviews.t: Great for not so common uses!
reviews.x: When faced with the daunting task of replacing a 15" drain tube in a boat, one asks themselves, "How the heck am I going to coat the inside of this opening with sealant?"  Did a little poking around Amazon and I found these wonderful hair rollers that were just the right size to get the job done. It wasn't pretty, as I coated the hair roller in tan-colored sealant and then repeatedly inserted the roller into the boat to generously coat the insides of the hole with sealant, but hey, I'll be darne

These curlers are great. I sleep with them in at night with damp hair. I put my long hair up into a high ponytail on top of my head, then use 2 of these babies. When I wake up, VOILA, supermodel hair. The key is to put the curlers on top of your head if you're going to sleep in them. Otherwise, they can be uncomfortable. I highly recommend these.

I use this to curl my hair. I put my hair up in pony tail on top of my head, I use a scrunchy so it does not hold to tight. I wet my hair and I put one curler on the top of my head, the next day I have great curl! So easy.  love the size, makes softer curls.

These rollers are great, they give a beautiful set of curls.The curls are not to tight they give medium curls with body. There easy to put in and are easier to sleep in than magnetic rollers. This size is hard to find, so I ordered a bunch on the internet.

reviews.t: Eh... Take it or leave it. They are now in a drawer not being used.
reviews.x: They don't stay when twisted because it's so large... Not really a fan of this. I've had the skinnier ones and those work 100% better.
My hair is down to my hips and is very easy to curl and I love the results I get with these and without heat!

reviews.t: Great heatless curls, but requires experimentation
reviews.x: I have long curly hair (3B) that I no longer straighten. Wanting to experiment with vintage hair styles and other looks without heat, I decided to give these rollers a try. I've used them a few times to varying degrees of success depending on the rolling technique I used, the dampness of my hair, and styling products. With that said, these absolutely DO work if you get the right combination of those three because I have managed really lovely loose curls once or twice. It takes trial and error. T

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise these rollers for creating long-lasting, bouncy curls without heat damage.
Many reviewers say the rollers are easy to use and comfortable, including for sleeping overnight.
Several reviewers note it takes practice or watching a tutorial video to get the wrapping method right.
Some reviewers report the curls loosen quickly or the rollers slip out, which others attribute to user error.
A few reviewers mention the rollers may be too large or thick for shorter or fine hair.
